accessibility.description: The diagram shows the pre-freeze Grafana baseline, failed older cutover, publication and freshness abort, completed rollback to stable generation 5 shadow, quarantined candidate, merged backend safeguards, unfinished worker and infra guards, and post-rollback mutation freeze.

review_notes: Resolved for this draft: the issue sequence, repository commits, workflow names and inputs, provider-credential mapping, Grafana catalog, evidence runs, and artifact digest were checked against the refreshed 2026-07-29 GitHub state.
Resolved for this draft: Backend Production Cutover is database-provider automation and is explicitly excluded from worker-ingestion promotion.

Resolved for this draft: the pinned infra controller config has the Durable Object binding but no FAILOVER_ANALYTICS binding; the guide records proof, migration, or residual-risk acceptance as a #125 gate.
Recheck these time-sensitive baselines whenever an owning repository changes; a mismatch is a readiness blocker until the guide is updated.

The 2026-08-01 rollback-finalize artifact proves stable generation 5 shadow; backend PRs #482 and #483 are merged source-only safeguards, while the worker deploy guard, infra verifier, and incident reconciliation remain frozen blockers.

Pre-freeze Grafana apply 30708192621 is live baseline evidence; it must not be confused with the still-frozen PR #473 hardening, native SLO, notification canary, controlled-drill, or post-incident verification work.
Backend PR #471 is conflicting and undeployed; reconcile PR #483, authoritative generation 5 ownership, and the separate exact-eight runtime-container recreation step before qualification.
